name: Exness
tagline: Lowest entry deposit and instant withdrawals

platforms: MT4, MT5, Exness Terminal, Exness Trade app
regulation: FCA (UK), CySEC (Cyprus), FSCA (South Africa), CMA (Kenya), FSA (Seychelles), FSC (Mauritius & BVI), CBCS (Curaçao)

summary: Exness is one of the largest retail forex brokers by trading volume. It is best known for its very low minimum deposit, tight spreads on gold and major pairs, and fast automated withdrawals. Traders outside the EU and UK are usually onboarded through its offshore entities, which offer higher leverage but weaker investor protection than tier-1 regulators.

summary: IC Markets is an Australian-founded ECN-style broker known for raw spreads, fast execution and broad platform choice. It is a favourite of scalpers and automated (EA) traders. The $200 recommended deposit is higher than most rivals, so it suits traders who already have some experience.

summary: PU Prime (Pacific Union) is an offshore-focused broker with a low-cost Cent account, MT4/MT5 and copy trading. It holds an FSCA licence in South Africa plus offshore licences. It suits new traders who want to start very small, but active traders should compare its Standard spreads with Exness or Vantage.

summary: Elev8 is a young multi-asset CFD broker launched in 2022, offering MT4, MT5 and its own TradingView-based Elev8Trader platform with a low minimum deposit and high leverage. It holds offshore licences in Mauritius, Seychelles and Comoros only, so investor protection is weaker than at FCA, ASIC or CySEC brokers. Independent reviews disagree on which countries it accepts, so confirm your country at sign-up.
